title: 第21章 秦墨雪第22章 武道元神
slug: 全球没功法的我自创功法
content_zh:
就在林道与秦墨雪，被那诡异气氛包裹时候，一声清脆悦耳且充满惊喜声，打破彼此之间尴尬氛围。
“呀！是你啊，没想到在这里碰到你，你也在这所学校上学吗？”
随着声音传来的方向看去，只见两道靓丽的身影，正缓缓朝这边走来。
其中一位女孩显得格外活泼可爱，她脸上洋溢着灿烂而欢喜的笑容，而另一位则神情略显倨傲，身姿高挑修长。
林道和秦墨雪同时，如释重负般长出了一口气。
林道抬起头，就见那位活泼的女孩，正满脸兴奋地望着自己。
林道适时露出迷茫表情道：“同学我们认识。”
王瑶表情一呆，惊讶道：“对哦，我们好像还不认识。”
在场三人表情一滞，然后同时无语看着王瑶。
秦墨雪见状，嘴角微扬，轻声说道：“你们回来啦，怎么去了这么长时间？”
王瑶立刻撅起小嘴，开始抱怨起来：“哎呀，墨雪你可不知道，今天人太多了，我和婷婷在那边排了好久的队，好不容易才轮到我们。”
说罢，还夸张地伸出两只手，比划着队伍的长度。
柳婷此时双手抱于胸前，不着痕迹扫了一眼，坐在长椅上的林道和秦墨雪，然后轻轻点了点头，应声道：“嗯，人确实是不少。”
柳婷内心深处，却暗自嘀咕：墨雪怎么会跟陌生的男生靠得如此之近。
林道见三人有话要说，就起身想要离开，毕竟自己待在这里不合适。
王瑶眼见帅气的男生即将离去，心急开口道：“帅……同学，你这就要走啦？我叫王瑶哦，可以加一下你的聊天方式吗？”
此刻，王瑶心里暗自期盼着，如果能够成功加上这位帅哥哥的联系方式，那可真是太棒了。
站在一旁的柳婷见状，不禁皱起眉头，下意识地就想要，制止闺蜜这种白给的举动。
对于她这个重度颜控的闺蜜，柳婷真是感到颇为无语，秦墨雪却不着痕迹地，轻轻扯了一下柳婷的衣袖，并向她微微摇了摇头。
柳婷瞬间醒悟，是啊，自己确实不应该管得太宽泛了。

虽说瑶瑶平日里天真烂漫、不拘小节，但她也并非愚笨之人，否则早就被人欺负了，再者说，还有自己和墨雪在旁边照看着嘛！
听到王瑶的话，正准备离开的林道，不由得身形一滞，脸上露出惊讶之色。
当他迎上王瑶渴望的目光时，略微迟疑片刻，还是轻声回答道：“我叫林道。”
言罢，他将视线转向其余的两位女生。
秦墨雪落落大方地道：“秦墨雪。”
相比之下，柳婷则显得冷淡道：“柳婷。”
紧接着，林道拿出手机，与王瑶相互交换了聊天方式，做完这些后，他看了一眼秦墨雪，便径直离开了这里。
秦墨雪盯着林道离开的背影若有所思。
王瑶望着手机上的联系方式，一脸花痴的站在那里傻笑。
柳婷见此情景不想搭理她，而是对秦墨雪问道：“墨雪你怎么跟他认识的。”
秦墨雪就把她跟林道事情说了一遍。
柳婷惊讶道：“就这么简单，不会他故意晕倒，然后接近你吧！”
秦墨雪眼神中闪过笑意道：“谁知道呢！”
自从昨天发生的超凡事件，让她的思想发生翻天覆地的变化，也让她对于修行，产生浓厚的兴趣。
content_en:
Just when Lin Dao and Qin Moxue were enveloped in the weird atmosphere, a clear, pleasant and surprising sound broke the awkward atmosphere between them.
"Ah! It's you. I didn't expect to meet you here. Do you also go to this school?"
Looking in the direction of the sound, I saw two beautiful figures walking slowly towards this side.
One of the girls looked particularly lively and cute, with a bright and joyful smile on her face, while the other looked slightly arrogant and had a tall and slender figure.
Lin Dao and Qin Moxue let out a sigh of relief at the same time.
Lindao raised his head and saw the lively girl looking at him with excitement.
Lin Dao showed a confused expression at the right time and said, "We know each other, classmate."
Wang Yao's expression was stunned and she said in surprise: "Yes, we don't seem to know each other yet."
The expressions of the three people present were stagnant, and then they looked at Wang Yao speechlessly.
Seeing this, Qin Moxue raised the corner of her mouth slightly and said softly: "You are back. Why have you been gone for so long?"
Wang Yao immediately pouted her lips and started to complain: "Oh, Mo Xue, you don't know, there are too many people today. Tingting and I waited in line over there for a long time, and it was not easy until it was our turn."
After that, he stretched out his two hands exaggeratedly to indicate the length of the team.
Liu Ting folded her hands in front of her chest and glanced at Lin Dao and Qin Moxue who were sitting on the bench. Then she nodded slightly and said, "Well, there are indeed a lot of people."
Deep in her heart, Liu Ting muttered to herself: How could Mo Xue get so close to a strange boy.
When Lin Dao saw that the three of them had something to say, he stood up and wanted to leave. After all, it was not appropriate for him to stay here.
Seeing that the handsome boy was about to leave, Wang Yao said anxiously: "Handsome...classmate, are you leaving now? My name is Wang Yao. Can you add your chat method?"
At this moment, Wang Yao was secretly looking forward to it. It would be great if she could successfully add the contact information of this handsome brother.
Liu Ting, who was standing aside, couldn't help frowning when she saw this, and subconsciously wanted to stop her best friend's free behavior.
Liu Ting was really speechless for her best friend who was very concerned about her appearance, but Qin Moxue gently pulled Liu Ting's sleeve without leaving any trace and shook her head slightly.
Liu Ting suddenly realized that, yes, she really shouldn't be too lenient.
Although Yaoyao is usually innocent and informal, she is not stupid, otherwise she would have been bullied long ago. Besides, she and Mo Xue are still watching over her!
After hearing Wang Yao's words, Lin Dao, who was about to leave, couldn't help but froze, with a look of surprise on his face.
When he met Wang Yao's longing gaze, he hesitated for a moment and then replied softly: "My name is Lin Dao."
After saying this, he turned his attention to the other two girls.
Qin Moxue said generously: "Qin Moxue."
In contrast, Liu Ting looked cold and said: "Liu Ting."
Immediately afterwards, Lin Dao took out his mobile phone and exchanged chat methods with Wang Yao. After doing this, he glanced at Qin Moxue and left here.
Qin Moxue stared at Lin Dao's leaving figure thoughtfully.
Wang Yao looked at the contact information on her phone and stood there with an infatuated look on her face, giggling.
Seeing this scene, Liu Ting didn't want to talk to her, but asked Qin Moxue: "Moxue, how did you get to know him?"
Qin Moxue told her and Lin Dao what happened.
Liu Ting said in surprise: "It's that simple. He couldn't have fainted on purpose and then approached you!"
Qin Moxue said with a smile in her eyes: "Who knows!"
Since the extraordinary event that happened yesterday, her thoughts have undergone earth-shaking changes, and she has also developed a strong interest in practice.
